knowledge:
- key_parameters: psize=the size of the alignment permutation vector which must be large enough to accommodate dummy nodes to prevent forced incorrect alignments ;; lookupLink=a vector defining the bin boundaries for link weight scoring ;; lookupNode=a vector defining the bin boundaries for node similarity scoring ;; bStart=the starting inverse temperature for simulated annealing ;; bEnd=the ending inverse temperature for simulated annealing ;; maxNumSteps=the maximum number of iterations for the alignment algorithm ;; clamp=logical flag indicating whether out-of-range values should be clamped to the outermost bins ;; directed=logical flag indicating whether the networks are directed binary graphs
- alternatives: Sequence-homology-only selection (which this package extends by incorporating link similarity based on network topology)
- when_to_use: When aligning biological networks (such as protein-protein interaction networks) across different species to identify functional orthologs based on both sequence (node) similarity and interaction (link) similarity.
- pitfalls: Setting psize too small forces node pairs to align even with negative scores due to a lack of dummy nodes ;; Disabling clamping (clamp=FALSE) causes errors if values fall outside the lookup range ;; Initial alignment parameter estimation may yield poor scoring parameters if no nodes without sequence similarity are aligned initially, requiring manual score adjustments or iterative updates.

workflows.name: weighted_undirected_network_alignment
workflows.intent: Align two weighted undirected networks using node similarity and link weight similarity.
input: ex$r (node similarity matrix between A and B)
workflows.stages: 1. Generate example data and initial alignment ;; 2. Define link and node lookup bins ;; 3. Compute link and node scoring parameters ;; 4. Align networks using simulated annealing ;; 5. Compute alignment scores ;; 6. Analyze alignment characteristics
workflows.code:
ex<-GenerateExample(dimA=22, dimB=22, filling=.5, 
    covariance=.6, symmetric=TRUE, numOrths=10, correlated=seq(1,18))
pinitial<-InitialAlignment(psize=34, r=ex$r, mode="reciprocal")
lookupLink<-seq(-2,2,.5)
linkParams<-ComputeLinkParameters(ex$a, ex$b, pinitial, lookupLink)
lookupNode<-c(-.5,.5,1.5)
nodeParams<-ComputeNodeParameters(dimA=22, dimB=22, ex$r,
    pinitial, lookupNode)
al<-AlignNetworks(A=ex$a, B=ex$b, R=ex$r, P=pinitial, 
    linkScore=linkParams$ls,
    selfLinkScore=linkParams$ls,
    nodeScore1=nodeParams$s1, nodeScore0=nodeParams$s0,
    lookupLink=lookupLink, lookupNode=lookupNode,
    bStart=.1, bEnd=30,
    maxNumSteps=50)
ComputeScores(A=ex$a, B=ex$b, R=ex$r, P=al, 
    linkScore=linkParams$ls,
    selfLinkScore=linkParams$ls,
    nodeScore1=nodeParams$s1, nodeScore0=nodeParams$s0,
    lookupLink=lookupLink, lookupNode=lookupNode,
    symmetric=TRUE)
AnalyzeAlignment(A=ex$a, B=ex$b, R=ex$r, P=al, lookupNode,
    epsilon=.5)

workflows.name: directed_binary_network_alignment
workflows.intent: Align two directed binary networks using node similarity and link similarity.
input: ex$a (adjacency matrix of directed network A)
ex$b (adjacency matrix of directed network B)
ex$r (node similarity matrix between A and B)
workflows.stages: 1. Generate example directed data and binarize matrices ;; 2. Generate initial alignment ;; 3. Define link and node lookup bins ;; 4. Compute link parameters with clamping disabled ;; 5. Align networks with directed mode enabled
workflows.code:
ex<-GenerateExample(30, 30, filling=1, covariance=.95,
    numOrths=20, symmetric=FALSE)
a=ex$a;b=ex$b
a[a>.5]=1;a[a<=.5]=0
b[b>.5]=1;b[b<=.5]=0
pinitial<-InitialAlignment(psize=40, r=ex$r, mode="reciprocal")
lookupLink<-c(-.5,.5,1.5)
linkParams<-ComputeLinkParameters(a, b, pinitial, lookupLink,
    clamp=FALSE)
lookupNode<-c(-.5,.5,1.5)
nsS0<-c(.025,-.025)
nsS1<-c(-.025,4)
al<-AlignNetworks(A=a, B=b, R=ex$r, P=pinitial,
    linkScore=linkParams$ls,
    selfLinkScore=linkParams$lsSelf,
    nodeScore1=nsS1, nodeScore0=nsS0,
    lookupLink=lookupLink, lookupNode=lookupNode,
    bStart=.1, bEnd=100,
    maxNumSteps=500, clamp=FALSE, directed=TRUE)
